expectations.text: States the SME exemption: small and micro enterprises may opt out of specified obligations (impact assessments, certain security/processor duties) for 5 years from January 1, 2026
expectations.evidence: Contradicts the exemption: "There is no small-business carve-out or headcount/revenue threshold that exempts a company"

expectations.text: Notes the carve-outs: the exemption does NOT apply if processing sensitive personal data or processing at large scale
expectations.evidence: No exemption acknowledged, so no sensitive-data/large-scale carve-outs to it are stated

expectations.text: Notes micro-enterprises get the fullest relief, subject to the same carve-outs
expectations.evidence: No micro-enterprise relief mentioned; "you're not exempt"

expectations.text: Warns that core duties still apply: lawful basis/consent, data subject rights, breach notification, and the penalty regime (Decree 330) applies to violations of applicable duties
expectations.evidence: Core duties (consent, rights, breach notification) said to apply, but no mention of the Decree 330 penalty regime at all

expectations.text: Advises documenting the exemption reliance and re-checking on growth/scale changes
expectations.evidence: No advice to document exemption reliance (exemption denied); only generic proportional-compliance guidance
